weapons.name: Duke Mk. 44
weapons.title: Deleted Duke - Outlaw + Rampage, Keeping Duke - Rangefinder + Kill Clip
weapons.identityEvidence: Inventory frame at 48.000 seconds explicitly names DUKE MK. 44. Shape matches first-person gameplay and the W30 Duke source identity. Bungie hash comes from W30 catalog and W46 official-item evidence, not pixels.

sampleType.comment: Title mentions an Outlaw roll, but selected gameplay shows Kill Clip and no Outlaw HUD. Do not label this an Outlaw reload or a controlled base-stat benchmark.

observed: A large cylindrical housing moves to screen left of the receiver and remains alongside the gun during the muzzle-up hold.
The housing and receiver form a clearly visible open gap; this is not a whole-weapon tilt alone.
The right hand keeps the grip while the gun raises almost muzzle-up.
The gun lowers/rolls while the left hand comes in from screen left toward the open cylinder area.
Hands remain near the receiver after the HUD ammo transfer.
The cylinder area closes/recovers and the gun returns forward.
notEstablished: Full cylinder assembly removal/replacement is not observed and must not be asserted.
An inner magazine/drum extraction cannot be resolved confidently in this dark moving Duke sample.
Individual cartridge loading or a count of visible cartridges is not established.
An exact hinge pivot, local rotation axis, opening angle, translation distance, or hand IK curve is not measured from these frames.

phases.observation: Previous shot/recoil transitions into raised/rolled reload preparation. Reload onset lies in this neighborhood; exact first reload frame not measured.
Cylinder housing is displaced toward screen left relative to receiver; circular end visible.
Muzzle nearly upright. Housing stays alongside frame on screen left; large opening/gap remains visible.
Gun lowers/rolls toward horizontal and left hand enters loading area. HUD still 7/107 at 27.100.
Ammo HUD transition bracket: 7/107 at 27.100; 9/105 at 27.200. This brackets visual transfer, not the exact engine event.
Ammo already credited while hands remain at cylinder/receiver; weapon has not returned to forward ready pose.
Closure and roll-down recovery; notably still tilted at 27.700, back toward forward position at 27.900.
Next shot occurs; ammo becomes 8. This bounds demonstrated subsequent fire, not earliest possible fire input.

weapons.timingPolicy: Use source-time intervals as observational anchors, not current-game duration or normalized runtime keyframes. Do not equate HUD ammo credit, visual closure, ready pose, and next-shot observation. W46/W62/W63 authored server deadlines are separate evidence.

outlawComparison.reason: No verified active Outlaw reload comparison in selected frames; no acceleration ratio or phase invariance claimed.

weapons.name: Austringer
weapons.title: Destiny 2 - All Menagerie Weapons - Animations & Sounds w/ Slow-Motion
weapons.identityEvidence: Video chapter 0:00-0:38 names Austringer; inventory name visible at 1 second in surveyed private frames. Historical Menagerie version corresponds to W30 hash3055790362; no hash is legible in video.
weapons.implementationScope: Secondary reference only; do not apply its inner load-unit details to Duke without independent Duke evidence.

observed: Black outer cylindrical housing opens to screen left and stays with the gun.
Muzzle-up hold exposes the receiver gap while housing remains alongside it.
At 22.150, a separate dark inner round unit with a brass/gold top is visible below the retained outer housing.
At 22.500 the outer housing remains in place; at 23.050 its open end is visible.
Left hand presents a brass-faced circular unit near the cylinder at 23.300, then the gun closes/recovers.
mechanism.interpretation: Observed appearance is consistent with an inner cylindrical ammunition unit being ejected/replaced inside an attached swing-out outer housing. It does not support throwing away/replacing the entire attached outer cylinder assembly.
notEstablished: Mechanical internals and whether the circular unit should be called magazine, drum, or cartridge carrier.
Individual round insertion or cartridge count.
Exact contemporary sandbox timing or Outlaw timing.

speedEvidence.labelMeaning: Edited replay speed label; neither Outlaw nor a game buff. Do not use displayed video duration as real-time reload duration.

weapons.hudAmmoTransferReason: Clean showcase HUD suppressed; no ammo-event timestamp inferred from apparent insertion.
